preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 10**6 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each binary string S in the test cases has a length between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
Each character in the binary strings S is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= len(S) for result, S in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and the length of the corresponding binary string S inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == min(flips_to_all_zeros(S), flips_to_all_ones(S)) for result, S in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is the minimum number of operations required to make all characters of the corresponding binary string S equal to either '0' or '1'.
